readerCopy.body: The current situation can put an old compliance pattern directly across from the part of you that refuses it. When Lilith opposes the South Node, you may feel pulled between playing the familiar role and rejecting it so completely that none of your existing skill can come with you. The past stays influential when every choice is either obedience or revolt. Keep what you learned. You do not have to keep the old terms in order to prove you are free of them.
